{{ToC|right}}
{{Hatnote|Brand new to the shard? Start at [[NewPlayers]]. For everything else UOAlive does differently, see [[Quality Of Life]].}}

Every command begins with a '''<code>[</code>'''. Type it like any other line of speech and press enter:

 <code>[MyCommands</code>

That one lists every command your character can currently use, in game, and it is always more current than this page. Everything below explains what those commands actually do, grouped by what you are trying to accomplish rather than by spelling.

{{Nutshell|Commands start with <code>[</code> and are not case sensitive.|You can use '''any skill''' by typing its name: <code>[hiding</code>, <code>[lore</code>, <code>[tracking</code>.|Most of the toggles you want are in [[#Toggles and defaults|Toggles and defaults]].}}

== Start here ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Command !! What it does
|-
| <code>[MyCommands</code> || Lists every command available to your character right now
|-
| <code>[Help</code> || Lists all commands
|-
| <code>[HelpInfo</code> || Lists all commands together with an explanation of each
|}

== Skill shortcuts ==

You can use '''any skill by typing its name'''. Some skills have shorter aliases, and a few shortenings are already taken by other commands, so <code>[hide</code> will not work but <code>[hiding</code> will.

== Money and rewards ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Command !! What it does
|-
| <code>[Wallet</code> || Your account balance, from anywhere. Gold is account-wide on UOAlive, so every character shares it. See [[Currencies]]
|-
| <code>[Store</code> || Opens the store
|-
| <code>[VeteranRewards</code> || Opens the veteran reward choices gump. See [[Veteran Rewards]]
|}

== Fixing things ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Command !! What it does
|-
| <code>[FixMe</code> || Opens a screen that helps fix problems with your character
|-
| <code>[ClearFollowers</code> || Use when you have a follower count but no followers actually in the world
|-
| <code>[OrganizeMe</code> || Organizes you. Well, it does
|-
| <code>[ReDeed</code> || Turns any house decoration item that would need an axe back into a deed, without needing an axe
|-
| <code>[WhatIsIt</code> || Tells you the name of the targeted item
|-
| <code>[AddSocket</code> || Attempts to add a socket to the targeted item
|-
| <code>[Password</code> || Changes your password without staff help
|}

'''Why <code>[Password</code> exists:''' some launchers, the ClassicUO Launcher included, cap logins at 12 characters. If your password is longer than that and a launcher will not take it, change it yourself rather than opening a ticket.

== Chat and emotes ==

[[File:200137.png|thumb|right|<code>[c</code> posts to global chat, server-wide.]]

{| class="wikitable"
! Command !! What it does
|-
| <code>[c</code> || Speak in [[Chat|Global Chat]]. Type <code>[c</code>, then your message, then enter, and it appears server-wide
|-
| <code>[ChatHistory</code> || Opens the Global Chat history
|-
| <code>[ChatToggle</code> || Turns Global Chat off and on. Default ON
|-
| <code>[DidISpam</code> || Tells you whether you are muted in Global Chat, and shows any spam messages you sent
|-
| <code>[e</code> || Performs an emote by name, for example <code>[e cough</code>
|-
| <code>[Emote</code> || Opens the [[Emote|emote list]]
|-
| <code>[Points</code> || Points at your target and states their name
|-
| <code>[PointsLanguage</code> || Sets the language the pointing system uses
|}

Global chat is mirrored into Discord, so anything you post with <code>[c</code> is visible outside the game.

== Finding people ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Command !! What it does

| <code>[Who</code> / <code>[WhoList</code> || Lists all connected clients, and filters the results by name
|-

|}

== Toggles and defaults ==

Everything on UOAlive that you can switch on or off, in one place.

{| class="wikitable"
! Command !! Default !! What it controls
|-
| <code>[ChatToggle</code> || ON || Global Chat
|-
| <code>[GhostPrompt</code> || ON || The resurrection gump that appears when your character dies
|-
| <code>[IDOCEffects</code> || ON || IDOC visual effects, individually toggleable
|-
| <code>[VerboseMobFactions</code> || ON || Whether faction gain and loss is reported to you on every kill
|-
| <code>[GuildLootOn</code> / <code>[GuildLootOff</code> || || Whether guildmates may loot your corpse. Turn it on if you need help with a corpse run
|-
| <code>[SeeKills</code> || || Whether you see other players' PvP kill broadcasts
|-
| <code>[BroadcastKills</code> || || Whether your own PvP kills are broadcast over Global Chat
|-
| <code>[ToggleChampionTierPopup</code> || || The automatic Champion Tier popup
|-
| <code>[Notify</code> || || Opens your notification settings
|}

'''Accessibility:''' if you are sensitive to flashing effects, suffer from migraines or seizures, or you are on a low-spec machine, <code>[IDOCEffects</code> turns IDOC visuals off for you alone. They are on by default.

== Staff commands ==

These appear in the command list but are gated. Typing them as a regular player does nothing.

{| class="wikitable"
! Command !! What it does
|-
| <code>[GiveToken</code> || Places a [[Mythic Character Token]] in the selected player's backpack
|-
| <code>[CreateEventMoongate</code> / <code>[DeleteEventMoongate</code> || Creates and removes event moongates. Only certain players have access
|-
| <code>[ClearRC</code> ||
|}

== Not a command, but worth knowing ==

* You can say '''"Release"''', '''"Lockdown"''' or '''"Secure"''' in a house instead of the much longer "I wish to lock this down".
* Left-click your character to control which title shows on your paperdoll.
